ExpressionSetDefinition.description: Decides whether a duplicate license may be issued and what it costs: one per license in each renewal period, every duplicate charged the Fee Schedule amount.
ExpressionSetDefinition.label: Fee Duplicate License

versions.description: Decides whether a duplicate license may be issued and what it costs: one per license in each renewal period, every duplicate charged the Fee Schedule amount.
versions.label: Fee Duplicate License V1

assignment.expression: ISBLANK(LastDuplicateDate) || ISBLANK(PeriodEndDate) || LastDuplicateDate <= IF(ADDMONTHS(PeriodEndDate, -12) <= TODAY(), ADDMONTHS(PeriodEndDate, -12), IF(ADDMONTHS(PeriodEndDate, 12 * (YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(PeriodEndDate))) > TODAY(), ADDMONTHS(PeriodEndDate, 12 * (YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(PeriodEndDate)) - 12), ADDMONTHS(PeriodEndDate, 12 * (YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(PeriodEndDate)))))

steps.description: True when no duplicate of the license was issued in the current renewal period: the twelve months before its expiration date, or, when the license was renewed early and that period has not started, the yearly period containing today.
steps.label: Set Is Allowed
steps.name: SetIsAllowed

steps.description: The duplicate fee, charged for every duplicate.
steps.label: Set Amount
steps.name: SetAmount

variables.description: When the last duplicate of this license was issued. Blank when there has been none.
variables.name: LastDuplicateDate

variables.description: The expiration date of the renewal period the duplicate is for: the license's current expiration, or the next one when the license is renewed on the same request. Blank allows the duplicate.
variables.name: PeriodEndDate

variables.description: Duplicate license fee from the Fee Schedule.
variables.name: DuplicateFee

variables.description: True when no duplicate of the license was issued in the current renewal period: the twelve months before its expiration date, or, when the license was renewed early and that period has not started, the yearly period containing today.
variables.name: IsAllowed

variables.description: The duplicate fee, charged for every duplicate.
variables.name: Amount
